hold_text: Phone-executor Kotlin (MainActivity.kt), the app that drives the breakout_2 prop order path, Tier 2. Read/diagnostic only: the background job posts the same masked terminal_miss the foreground already posts (at most every 30 min) and the heartbeat reports the FLAG_SECURE state. No order, amend or cancel path, no claim gate and no terminal().ready change. Needs an APK build (phone-executor-apk) and the operator installing it on the phone; the server half (two heartbeat allowlist keys) is Tier 2 and harmless without the APK.
why: 2026-11-07 breakout_2 was silent for 30 h: the background engine treats an unrecognised page as 'busy' and posts nothing, so the structure dump and the phone_executor_anomaly alert shipped in #24033 never fire in background mode (no terminal_miss since 08:44Z, measured on /api/bot/prop/status after the phone loaded exec.js 2026-11-07.1). The secure state gives the screenshot/FLAG_SECURE question evidence instead of a guess.
